basic_details.job_title: CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute (CSIR-CGCRI) has released a recruitment notification for 1 project-based Project Associate - I post in Kolkata. The engagement is project-based with a tenure initially for 1 year and extendable up to 31 March 2031 based on the availability of fund. Eligible candidates must hold an M.Sc. in Chemistry / Applied Chemistry / Materials Science / Microbiology or B.E. / B.Tech. / M.E. / M.Tech. in Materials Science/ Material Science and Metallurgical Engineering / Metallurgical Engineering / Ceramics / Chemical. The notified pay is Rs. 25,000 p.m. + HRA

important_dates.raw: Last Date for Receipt of Application: 03/11/2026 Walk-in-Interview Date: 05/11/2026 at 11:00 a.m.

how_to_apply: Download the application form in the prescribed format from the official website.
Fill out the Application Form completely with typed text (hand-written applications are not accepted).
Enclose soft copies of self-attested copies of all supporting documents, certificates, and reprints.
Send the soft copy of the filled-up application and attachments via email to [email protected] by 03/11/2026.
Bring the original marksheets, certificates, age-proof documents, project thesis (if any), and self-attested copies of all documents at the time of the interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I at a Glance

rows.details: Development of advanced bioceramic and bioactive glass based multi-functional systems for orthopedic reconstruction, dental restoration and wound healing applications.
Initially for 1 Year and extendable upto 31.03.2031 based on the availability of fund.
Rs. 25,000/- p.m. + HRA as admissible p.m.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the essential qualification specified for the post. Desirable qualifications and experience in materials synthesis or manufacturing and physical / chemical / biological testing of materials will be given preference.

rows.essential_qualification_required: M.Sc. in Chemistry (Specialization in physical / Inorganic) / Applied Chemistry / Materials Science/ Microbiology with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA/DGPA; Or B.E. / B.Tech. /M.E. / M.Tech. in Materials Science/ Material Science and Metallurgical Engineering / Metallurgical Engineering / Ceramics / Chemical / Biotechnology/ Biomedical Engineering
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience on materials synthesis or manufacturing and physical / chemical / biological testing of materials will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a stipend of Rs. 25,000/- p.m. plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible per month. The tenure is initially for one year and is extendable up to 31 March 2031 depending on fund availability.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I
content_sections.text: Download the application form in the prescribed format from the official website. Fill out the Application Form completely with typed text (hand-written applications are not accepted). Enclose soft copies of self-attested copies of all supporting documents, certificates, and reprints. Send the soft copy of the filled-up application and attachments via email to [email protected] by 03/11/2026. Bring the original marksheets, certificates, age-proof documents, project thesis (if any), and self-attested copies of all documents at the time of the interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at least ONE HOUR before the scheduled time of interview for verification of documents. No candidate will be allowed to enter the institute if arriving after Reporting Time. The original marksheets, certificates, age-caste proof, and project thesis must be brought with candidates at the time of interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Last Date for Receipt of Application : 03/11/2026 Walk-in-Interview Date : 05/11/2026 at 11:00 a.m.

faq.question: Q1. Is this post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The engagement is project-based, with a tenure initially for 1 year and extendable up to 31 March 2031 based on the availability of fund.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the position carries a stipend of Rs. 25,000/- p.m. plus HRA as admissible per month.

faq.question: Q3. Who gets an age relaxation and how much?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, which is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped and Female candidates, and up to 3 years for OBCs (Non-Creamy layer candidates).

faq.question: Q4. What documents should be sent or brought for verification?
faq.answer: Candidates must send soft copies of self-attested supporting documents with their application and must bring original marksheets, certificates, age-caste proof, and project thesis at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the deadline to send the application?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application via email is 03/11/2026.
